# runzero_license (Data Source)

Fetches the RunZero account license details.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `activated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the license was activated.
- `address_city` (String) City.
- `address_country` (String) Country.
- `address_postal` (String) Postal or ZIP code.
- `address_region` (String) Region or state.
- `address_street` (String) Street address.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the license was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the license.
- `license_expiration` (Number) Unix timestamp when the license expires.
- `license_live_asset_count` (Number) Current count of live assets.
- `license_max_assets` (Number) Maximum number of assets allowed by the license.
- `license_project_asset_count` (Number) Current count of project assets.
- `license_type` (String) The type of license.
- `name` (String) The name on the license.
- `partner` (String) Partner identifier.
- `phone` (String) Contact phone number.
- `sso_default_role` (String) Default role assigned to SSO users.
- `sso_domain` (String) SSO domain.
- `sso_login_issuer_url` (String) SSO login issuer URL.
- `sso_login_login_url` (String) SSO login URL.
- `sso_login_logout_url` (String) SSO logout URL.
- `sso_login_message` (String) SSO login message displayed to users.
- `sso_mode` (String) SSO mode.
- `sso_type` (String) SSO provider type.
- `subscription_cancel_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the subscription is scheduled to cancel.
- `subscription_canceled_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the subscription was canceled.
- `subscription_period_end` (Number) Unix timestamp of the subscription period end.
- `subscription_period_start` (Number) Unix timestamp of the subscription period start.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the license was last updated.
- `via_reseller` (Boolean) Whether the license was obtained via a reseller.
